factions.name: Separatist Alliance
factions.source: Star Wars: Legion Separatist Alliance (Atomic Mass Games), converted for 5P:T
factions.notes: The Confederacy's droid army (Star Wars: Legion, Atomic Mass Games). Distances are already Independent Action values (book ×1.5): run with IA OFF and both multipliers at 1. Points are hand-set to Legion balance: approximate Legion points ×1.5, which puts a B1 squad near the book price of a comparable squad; Legion characters and tanks come out pricier than book equivalents because Legion prices them that way. Legion reference values are approximate; check them against your unit cards. Force users are converted as duelists with telekinesis only; Sith, Nightsister and Nightbrother elements are removed by design. Shadow Collective units in the Separatist card pack (Pyke Syndicate, Black Sun) are not included.

rules.name: Droid (Synthetic)
rules.text: Book Synthetic rules (p.46): no Fear; immune to gas, Burn, Stun and Shock; no Medics; no campaign experience. Droids are Suppressed and test Morale normally.

rules.name: Battle Droid Protocols
rules.text: A unit with this rule that is not within 12" of a friendly Leader with Command Network when it activates makes an AI roll: on 1–3 it may only Engage the closest visible enemy without moving (or Move toward it if none is visible).

rules.name: Command Network
rules.text: Separatist Leaders may give Direct Command to any droid unit within 12" (not 2"), without joining it.

rules.name: Expendable
rules.text: B1 squads do not cause Morale tests in other friendly units when they lose figures.

rules.name: Heavy Droid Trooper
rules.text: Ignores Linear-feature cover penalties when firing over barricades; may move after a close assault ends.

rules.name: Flight
rules.text: Geonosians move over terrain and up buildings without movement cost; they cannot end a move in mid-air.

rules.name: Saber Duelist
rules.text: Lightsaber wielders roll one extra close assault die and may re-roll a failed close assault Hit once per activation.

rules.name: Saber Deflection
rules.text: 5+ save against ranged Hits (cannot combine with other saves). On a natural 6 the shot strikes the firer's unit.

rules.name: Telekinetic (psionic)
rules.text: Psi-Weapon powers only (push and hurl). No mind control, no lightning, no dark-side abilities.

rules.name: Paired [W]
rules.text: Two weapons: roll one extra attack die.
